{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "Disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "sfp.replace",
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again. Don't reboot the whole unit unless that fails.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Did that. Traffic is back 👍",
    "about_entity": "TRN-042"
  },
  "reason": "An expert explains that on older units after an SFP replacement, if the interface is UP with zero traffic counters, the interface should be bounced rather than replacing the SFP again or rebooting the node."
}
